market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver currently trades near $30–35. Hitting $120 by June 2026 would require a ~4x rally in ~14 months, surpassing the all-time high by more than 2x. No modern precedent exists for such a rapid move absent hyperinflation or global financial meltdown, making a price above 1% extremely unlikely.
evidence_points: Silver spot price ~$32 (Apr 2025) and all-time highs ~$50 (1980, 2011). $120 is ~4x current and >2x ATH.
Futures markets show no term structure or options skew indicating any material probability of $120 within 14 months.
The CME settlement methodology uses front-month active contract; a spike would need official daily settlement at that level, not just an intraday print.
